title: User Merge Pages
prompt: A TypeScript API client receives pages of users. Write a generic function that returns all page items in page order.

explanation.beginner:
Example: userMergePages([{"items":[1,2]},{"items":[3]}]) produces [1,2,3]. The result must follow this precise rule: A TypeScript API client receives pages of users. Write a generic function that returns all page items in page order. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “handles empty pages”: input [[{"items":[]},{"items":["a"]}]] produces ["a"]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
